title: Camel & Ink
intro: A quiet-luxury autumn palette: warm camel against deep ink. Soft, grounded, and endlessly wearable from desk to dinner.

title: One Skirt, Three Ways
intro: One beige A-line midi skirt, three ways to wear it — from the desk, through the weekend, into the evening. Keep the hero piece; change everything around it.

pieces.name: Deconstructed Pleated Cotton Midi Skirt
pieces.why: A sharp central pleat makes it read unmistakably as a skirt; beige is the neutral that works back to every colour.

pieces.name: Rounded Wool Crew-Neck Jumper — cream
pieces.why: Fine-gauge wool in cream — soft and tonal tucked into the skirt for the desk.

pieces.name: Classic Leather Loafers
pieces.why: Leather, not canvas — the flat that still looks grown-up at a desk.

pieces.name: Classic Leather Tote
pieces.why: Holds a laptop and keeps its shape — the one bag that works all week.

pieces.name: Deconstructed Pleated Cotton Midi Skirt
pieces.why: A sharp central pleat makes it read unmistakably as a skirt; beige is the neutral that works back to every colour.

pieces.name: Oversized Knit Jumper — navy blue
pieces.why: An oversized navy knit relaxes the skirt for the weekend — same piece, different energy.

pieces.name: Pointed Leather Ballet Flats
pieces.why: Pointed flats keep a day-off look neat without reaching for heels.

pieces.name: Mini Folded Crossbody Shopper
pieces.why: Hands-free leather crossbody — everything you need for errands, nothing you don't.

pieces.name: V-Detail Boiled Wool Funnel-Neck Jumper
pieces.why: A boiled-wool funnel neck with a soft V gives the skirt an evening top with structure, not sparkle.

pieces.name: Deconstructed Pleated Cotton Midi Skirt
pieces.why: The one skirt — beige cotton twill with a front pleat; the common thread across all three looks.

pieces.name: Strap-Detail Leather Pumps
pieces.why: The same pointed pumps from Studio Noir — a sharp toe lifts the midi for evening.

pieces.name: Parquet Clutch Bag — Eel-Effect Leather

pieces.name: Mini Chunky Hoop Earrings
pieces.why: Small gold hoops keep the black-and-beige warm without shouting.

title: Three Ways Off-Duty
intro: Three easy off-duty outfits for a quiet-luxury autumn weekend — a brown cashmere turtleneck with a silk scarf, a cream oversized knit with barrel jeans, and a grey funnel-neck half-zip over a white tee with a black beanie and straight-leg denim. One relaxed mood, three ways to wear it. Tap any look to shop every piece.

title: Stone & Noir
intro: Grey and black, nothing louder. A stone-and-noir colour story for quiet-luxury autumn and winter dressing — soft dark-grey wool over a crisp white shirt against clean black tailoring. Every piece linked to the retailer.

pieces.name: Dark Grey Roll-Neck Wool-Mix Jumper
pieces.why: A wool-mix roll neck in soft dark grey — the stone half of the palette, warm and quietly textured.

pieces.name: Marcy Pleated-Cuff Shirt
pieces.why: A crisp white shirt with pleated cuffs — collar and cuffs peek out of the knit for a polished, considered edge.

pieces.name: Pleated Wide-Leg Trousers
pieces.why: A single front pleat and a wide leg — the fluid black base that lengthens the line against the grey knit.

pieces.name: Classic Leather Loafers
pieces.why: Clean black leather loafers — the quiet shoe that keeps the look grounded and easy to walk in.

pieces.name: Classic Tote Bag — Leather
pieces.why: A structured black leather tote — holds the day and finishes the noir side of the palette.

pieces.name: Mismatched Knotted Earrings
pieces.why: Small gold knotted earrings — the one warm accent against the grey and black.

title: The Quiet Neutral Capsule
intro: Six outfits, one quiet neutral palette — cream, camel and ink. Proof that a tight colour story makes a small wardrobe feel limitless, from the desk to the evening. Every piece linked to the retailer.
